name: Universal Substitution-Test Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite binary tests; nonempty proper tests use the fiber criterion, while constants reduce to sections times cubes.
statement: The universal quantifier over all represented outer classes is equivalent to checking the single three-section class $H_T$.
proof: A maximum parent of $H_T$ yields four consecutive maximum classes whose marked sections are empty, $T$, its complement, and the full cube. The fiber-replacement theorem inserts the appropriate middle class over every unique-height fiber of any supplied maximum parent, proving universal substitution. Conversely, substituting $T$ into the rank-one three-edge path with shores $\{00,01\}$ and $\{01,11\}$ produces $H_T$.
